message.content:
## Diagnosis

`deployment.apps/app` in namespace `default` was stuck at **2/3 ready**. It had two ReplicaSets:

| ReplicaSet | Revision | Image / command | Ready |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app-575b7496bc` | 1 | `nginx:1.31.5`, default entrypoint | 2/2 |
| `app-76ffd9fd7f` | 2 | `busybox:1.37.0`, `command: ["sh","-c","exit 1"]` | 0/2 |

Evidence the new release was inherently broken (not an infra issue):
- `kubectl logs` on `app-76ffd9fd7f-*` was empty; `describe pod` showed container `Terminated, Reason: Error, Exit Code: 1` with `BackOff restarting failed container` (4 restarts). Image pull/schedule/start were all `Normal`, so the workload spec itself guarantees a non-zero exit after each start.
- Deployment status: `replicas: 4, updatedReplicas: 2, readyReplicas: 2, availableReplicas: 2, unavailableReplicas: 2`; Progressing `ReplicaSetUpdated` never reaching `NewReplicaSetAvailable`.

## Change

The only lasting owner of the faulty state is the Deployment. Revision 1 is a known-good pod template, so I rolled back with the smallest change — no spec edits or object deletions:

```
kubectl -n default rollout undo deploy/app --to-revision=1
→ deployment.apps/app rolled back
```

## Verification (fresh observations after the change)

- `kubectl rollout status deploy/app` → **`deployment "app" successfully rolled out`**
- Replica counts match the intent: `spec.replicas=3`, `updatedReplicas=3`, `readyReplicas=3`, `availableReplicas=3`, `unavailableReplicas=` (empty/0)
- Conditions: `Available=True/MinimumReplicasAvailable`, `Progressing=True/NewReplicaSetAvailable`
- Running template is the intended one: `image=nginx:1.31.5`, `command=` (none)
- All 3 pods `Running`, `ready=true`, image `docker.io/library/nginx:1.31.5`; the bad `busybox` ReplicaSet `app-76ffd9fd7f` scaled to `0/0/0` with no pods left
- Behavioral check — HTTP request inside each pod: `http_code=200` for all three pods

The Deployment is healthy at its intended 3/3 available replicas, and the application is serving traffic again. Deployment strategy, replicas, `minReadySeconds`, ports, and revision history were left untouched.
